answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using coastal hydroacoustic attestation rather than trusting a centralized walled garden. To register, each node must continuously sample an ambient acoustic signal scattered across an offshore reef. This forces an adversary to commit scarce, geographically isolated submerged hydrophone units and marine telemetry links per identity. However, dynamic vessel traffic and tidal turbulence introduce phase noise that occasionally causes false rejections.
